reason: I'd take the free 15-company list, sure, but EUR 500 plus up to EUR 3,600 for meetings is real money for a company our size, and my partner will say we could get Apollo and a junior SDR for less and keep the know-how in-house. Nothing gets signed off in the first month anyway.
objection: EUR 450 a meeting feels steep when a meeting is not an order. In wholesale one meeting rarely turns into a contract, so I could pay EUR 4,100 and still have zero new customers, while a junior SDR would at least stay with us.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies turned out to include buyers I really could not reach myself, and the reference client in distribution told me the meetings actually turned into orders, I could take that to my partner and run a smaller pilot of 3 to 4 meetings.
